meaning: Plausible in-vivo adult Drosophila spike-rate ranges (Hz, population mean per cell over the window). spontaneous_hz applies to baseline windows, driven_hz to stimulus windows. A bound is a sanity range, not a target.

ORN.basis: spontaneous: Hallem 2006 empty-neuron SFR 1-47 Hz for 24 Ors, read from DoOR.data (verified); driven ceiling: Hallem 2004 value 245 spikes/s for Or85b to OCT via DoOR.data (unverified provenance)

PN.basis: UNVERIFIED: recalled or secondary; not read from the source. Wide soft bound until a library check. Wilson et al. 2004; Bhandawat et al. 2007 (doi 10.1038/nn1976).

KC.basis: UNVERIFIED: recalled or secondary; not read from the source. Wide soft bound until a library check. Near-silent at rest, a few spikes per odour: Turner, Bazhenov & Laurent 2008 (doi 10.1152/jn.01283.2007).

MBON.basis: UNVERIFIED: recalled or secondary; not read from the source. Wide soft bound until a library check. Hige et al. 2015.

DNa02.basis: UNVERIFIED: recalled or secondary; not read from the source. Wide soft bound until a library check. Rayshubskiy et al. 2025 (rates in figures only).

GF.basis: UNVERIFIED: recalled or secondary; not read from the source. Wide soft bound until a library check. The GF is silent at rest and fires about one spike per escape (von Reyn 2014, abstract-level).

LC_looming.basis: UNVERIFIED: recalled or secondary; not read from the source. Wide soft bound until a library check. von Reyn 2017; Ache 2019.

LPTC.basis: UNVERIFIED: recalled or secondary; not read from the source. Wide soft bound until a library check. HS/VS respond with graded potentials and few spikes (Schnell et al. 2010; Joesch et al. 2008); the LIF proxy can only spike, so this bound tests that it does not spike at high rates.

brain_mean.basis: DESIGN CHOICE, not a literature value: excludes the v1 runaway (~6 Hz mean, 1e6 spikes/s). Shiu 2024 used 0 Hz baselines and warns absolute rates are unreliable.

brain_max_single_neuron.basis: DESIGN CHOICE: no neuron sustained above 300 Hz over a window, well below the 1/t_ref ~ 450 Hz refractory ceiling where LIF output saturates.

hallem2006.citation: Hallem EA, Carlson JR (2006) Coding of odors by a receptor repertoire. Cell 125:143-160
hallem2006.doi_status: matches DoOR.data records; not resolved online
values_read: spontaneous firing of 24 Ors in the empty-neuron system, 1-47 Hz (SFR row)
OCT and MCH were NOT in the 110-odour set

munch2016.citation: Münch D, Galizia CG (2016) DoOR 2.0 - Comprehensive mapping of Drosophila melanogaster odorant responses. Sci Rep 6:21841
values_read: consensus responses (0-1 per receptor, spontaneous-subtracted as reset_sfr does) for 3-octanol and 4-methylcyclohexanol; receptor -> glomerulus mapping (sources/door2_orn_responses_oct_mch_bza.json)

rayshubskiy2025.citation: Rayshubskiy A, et al., Wilson RI (2025) eLife 13:RP102230 (preprint bioRxiv 2020.04.04.024703)
rayshubskiy2025.read: text; no absolute DNa02 firing rates in the text (figures only)
values_read: DNa02 activity predicts and unilateral activation evokes ipsilateral turning (decoder convention, inherited from WP5)

vonreyn2014.citation: von Reyn CR, et al., Card GM (2014) A spike-timing mechanism for action selection. Nat Neurosci 17:962-970
values_read: short/long takeoff split at 6.87 ms wing-raise+jump duration; pooled r/v 14, 40, 70 ms: 95 short vs 355 long (n = 450)
short-mode fraction declines linearly with log(r/v): slope -19.27 (units as printed), R^2 = 0.903; n = 108, 115, 202, 133, 102 flies at r/v 8, 14, 40, 70, 140 ms
a GF spike forces a short-mode takeoff; the GF has a higher activation threshold than the parallel pathways (abstract)

vonreyn2017.citation: von Reyn CR, et al., Card GM (2017) Feature integration drives probabilistic behavior in the Drosophila escape response. Neuron 94:1190-1204
values_read: LC4 conveys angular velocity, LPLC2 angular size; the GF integrates them (qualitative; encoder assumption)

ache2019.citation: Ache JM, et al., Card GM (2019) Neural basis for looming size and velocity encoding in the Drosophila giant fiber escape pathway. Curr Biol 29:1073-1081
values_read: LC4 (velocity) and LPLC2 (size) inputs to the GF, summed approximately linearly (qualitative; encoder assumption)

shiu2024.citation: Shiu PK, et al. (2024) A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing. Nature 634:210-219
shiu2024.read: Nature page and bioRxiv full text
values_read: whole-brain LIF with 0 Hz baseline for every neuron; authors state absolute firing-rate predictions are unlikely to be accurate
